verdict.rationale: YubiKey's core design explicitly prevents exporting the data it stores — private keys are generated on-device and 'cannot be exported or extracted' (yubikey-docs-23), and SSH/FIDO2 docs stress private keys 'never leave the hardware' (yubikey-docs-5). There is no vendor or community evidence of any open-format bulk data export/portability path; the product's security model is fundamentally opposed to this story.
